tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nag po chen po'i las mtha' sreg pa hoṃ gyi gzer bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rdo rje'i slob dpon dpal 'brug pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// che cher gnag gzugs 'od kyi srid pa'i mun pa bcom// ha har bzhad pas mtshan rtog thams cad skrag nas byed// brtse brtses rjes gzung sdig can srog la mthar byed mtshon// de des mnyam med kun mnyam mdzad pa chos skyong ba'i// phyogs der dad pa'i mgo bo btud gyur pa// puṇ+ḍa rī ka 'di 'dod legs bshad ni// nyi ma'i 'od zer dang rtse myur ched snyam// dpyod ldan skyed tshal skyong bas dgongs gyur kyang*// gdengs gsum sbrang rtsis myos 'gyur bas// mngon spyod mdung rnon 'chang rnams la// bstan dgra dme sha can gsod pa'i// skabs dbyer yin snyam bdag yus so// 'dir rtsa rgyud le'u nyer brgyad pa'i// ba lang sha dang rta sha dang*// khyi sha dag dang bya dag gi /dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas nas ni// sangs rgyas rnams kyang nges par 'jig /ces pa'i lung 'dis nag po chen po'i sgo nas bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa sgrol ba'i phyir sgrub pa brtsams/ las la sbyor ba mnan bsreg 'phang gsum las sreg pa yang bshad pa de la sdang ba'i sems kyis/ drag po la shis pa'i gza' skar tshes dus sbyor gyi nyi ma phyed dam mtshan phyed la/ sa gzhi rtsub cing tsha sgo can kha dog nag cing gas pa dur sa'am/ 'jig rten gyi ma mo'i gnas sa/ grong khyer la sogs pa'i lhor/ thab khung gru gsum pa rgyar sor mo nyi shu/ phyed kyi srid dang ldan pa/ nang du sor bcu thur du brkos pa/ kha nas sor gsum phyir bor ba'i kha khyer sor gsum gyi dpangs zheng can/ sa nag dang bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs dang*/ ro thal dang*/ phub ma dang sol phye bsres pas phyi nang byugs/ rtse byang du bstan/ dri mi zhim pa'i me tog dang 'bru nag dang phub ma gtor/ nang du khro bo'i rdo rje rtse gsum sor brgyad pa'i tshad/ phyi zur la sna tshogs rdo rje/

rtse gsum rdo rje thob bri/ kha khyer ral gris bskor/ bud shing dri mi zhim pa/ ro kha ba/ tsher ma rno ba'i shing*/ dur khrod du skyes pa'am/ lha 'dre drag po gnas sar skyes pa skam po dang*/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs skam po dang*/ nim pa dang*/ seng ldeng gi shing 'ug pa'i sgro dang bcas pa thab las cung zad dma' bar rtsig sgrub pa po'i g.yon du yam shing sreg shing*/ bud shing du bshag pa'i shing rnying pa rtse nyams pa shun pa med cing gas pa/ thung ring sbom 'khyog po grum chag 'bus zos/ srog chags ldan pa bskams pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i cha las/ tshad sor bcu gnyis pa/ rtse gnyis rtsub pa'am rno ba/ dug khrag zhag chen pos sbags pa/ tsha ba'am yungs kar ram zhun chen gyi mar khu/ khrag dang lan tshwa dang ke tshe dang nim pa'i lo ma/ dur khrod kyi rus thal/ bong bu rnga mong gi sbangs dang skra dang zhag bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro/ bshang gci/ ba lang khyi khyim bya'i sha gzhan sha khrag 'bru nag ci rnyed pa dug khrag smyo byed kyi khu bas sbangs pa sreg rdzas su bya/ sgrub dus kyi lid+ga gdab las kyis bsgral ba de dum bur gtubs pa/ rjes shul gyis/ bag zan/ khrag dug sol pa bsres pa'i ling chung brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'jig rten pa la 'bul rgyu bdun dang bcas pa bya/ g.yas su lcags kyi snod du khrag dang ko ṭa pa'i khu ba dang*// mi'am ba lang ngam/ bong bu'i gcin gyi mchod yon/ chen po drug gi nyer mchod/ sman rag gtor gsum rim pa gnyis gnyis tshogs kyi mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ 'dir dgang gzar ni yu ba sor bcu drug dkyus sor bzhi pa zabs su sor gnyis pa khru gsum pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ nang gi grwa gsum la stag dang sbrul dang*/ seng ge'i gdong pas mtshan pa/ mar 'dzag pa'i bu ga sor gcig pa/ mchu rdo rje gdengs pa 'bar ba sor gcig pa'o// blugs gzar ni yu ba sor bcu gnyis pa/

dkyus sor gsum pa/ zabs sor gcig pa gru gsum sngar bzhin gyis mtshan pa/ yu ba'i mthar rdo rje rtse gsum pa gdengs pas mtshan pa mngon spyod kyi dgang blugs yin la/ rgyu thog brgyab ba'i shing ngam lcags sam tsher ma rnon bo yod pa'i shing la byas pa bshams/ bdud ging chas su zhugs pa'am/ rnam snang dang ro sol dang khrag bsres pa'i byug pas lus byugs te gcer bu skra lhug par bshams/ kha zas sha dpa' bo'i btung bas ngar bskyed stan sra zhing rtsub pa'am ro gdan bris par stang stabs khro bo'i skyil krung*/ ming gzhan dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs byas/ kha lhor bltas/ khro gnyer dang bcas pa'i gdong*/ bgegs la gtor ma btang*/ bskrad mtshams bcad/ bdag bskyed bde mchog khro bo'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas las thams cad pa'i chus rdzas rnams bsangs/ sha chen dang gu gul gyis bdugs/ oṃ ma hā kā la che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ btags pas lan bdun/ nyer spyad hūm̐ las de dag tu bskyed/ oṃ swā hā rdzas bkrus/ oṃ a swā hā yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hā mar khu/ oṃ dz+riṃswā hā/ 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de las gzhan pa rnams sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha rdzas/ zhal du gsol rgyu rnams dgra bo'i sha khrag rus/ yaṃ shing gdug pa can gyi shing du bskyed/ de nas bsang gtor bya/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge / nas/ che ge 'di la mngon spyod mdzod// oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ lan gsum gyi rang gi g.yas phyogs nas thab kyi kha khyer la rtse mo lhor bstan nas g.yon skor du bkram/ gshan pa'i khyim nas me blangs bsangs/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ zhes pas spar/ lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs/ legs par sbar/ de nas thab las thams cad pas bsangs/ bh+ruṃ las drag po'i thab khung zur gsum pa nag po rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa kha khyer ral gris mtshan pa de'i nang du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su khro bo'i me lha za byed dud pa'i mdog ba spu ser po/

gdong bdun lcags kyi lugs ma'i zhal can mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa res gza' bdun gyi bdag nyid kyi ljags glog ltar 'khyugs cing 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum steng du mi g.yo bar gzigs pa/ gos sngon po dang lcags kyi rgyan bzang pos brgyan zhing phyag bzhi dang po gnyis mdung dang rdo rje/ lhag ma gnyis ral gri dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ stobs dang drag shul chen po bskal pa'i me ltar drag po'i 'od du ba'i 'phreng ba dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa 'jig rten gsum gsal bar byed pa/ ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i g.yas su nag po kha ser dang mdun du mthar byed mdog nag po mig dud pa'i mdog can/ tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang gri gug g.yon gnyis khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa 'od zer dmar po/ g.yon du gshin rje mthar byed dang nag po gnyis zhal drug spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag drug be con gtun shing*/ ral gri dang thod khrag ro langs dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhi pa ma he la zhon pa bzhi ka lcags kyi rgyan can/ ltogs shing zas 'dod pa yi dwags kyi rgyal po ltar drag cing bya ba byed pa de dag gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi shar lho'i phyogs nas me lha za byed chen po blon po bka' nyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa/ hūm̐ 'jig rten khams kyi shar lho'i phyogs// 'bar ba me yi dkyil 'khor nas// rgyal ba'i bstan srung gdug pa'i gshed// phyogs skyong chen po drag shul can// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ ag+ne ya/ ā dī pya/

ā dī pya/ ā be sha ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya/ ma hā na ya swā hā/ mdun du spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs oṃ sum+bha nis bskrad/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ ag+ne ya swā hā/ byon skyems lan bdun phul/ de nas oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon thugs prok+ṣa naṃ/ bsang gtor sku/ añca mā naṃ zhal phyag bsil/ de nas/ hūm̐ dbang po'i me tog sprin du 'thibs// bsur chen spos kyi na bun 'thul// zhun chen mar me'i glog 'od 'bar// khrag chen byug pa'i char pa bsnyil// sha rus snying zas mtsho ru 'khyil// rkang gling thod rnga'i 'brug sgra ldir// de 'dra'i mchod rdzas mi bzad pa// nyams pa'i dgra bo 'joms phyir 'bul// nyer spyod lnga rol mo'i sngags sbrel bas mchod/ srid gsum sgrol phyir dza gad phud// khams gsum dbang byed rak+ta'i mtsho// 'phrin las kun 'grub ba ling ta// nyams pa'i= sman rag dang gtor sngags kyis phul/ hūm̐ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa'i// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong mchog /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs// gdug pa sgrol ba'i mtshon cha bsnams// drag shul chen po'i 'khor gyis bskor// za byed chen po khyod la bstod// de nas me dbus kyi lha la/ lag pa g.yon 'jig rten pa'i khu tshur byas/ g.yas 'bar ba ltar byas te/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭ dṛ ṣ+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma pas+t+waṃ/ sa ma yas+t+waṃ a haṃ/ 'khor bcas dam tshig la gnas par gyur pas sku las sprul pa dpag tu med pa bkye/

che ge mo'i mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ snying gar lcags kyus btab/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams nas/ rgyab nas pho nya dang las kyi rlung dmar gyis ded/ 'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun bsus/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon/ me ri 'bar bas mtha' bskor nas nya'u la bstim/ bden pa brjod/ dam tshig gi sngags/ duṣ+ṭāṃ gyi mthar bigh+nāṃ btags pa me lha'i snying por che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pas bsgral te/ lid+ga rkang pa g.yon nas sam/ mgo nas brtsams te gtubs/ de nas khro bo'i khu tshur gyis dgang blugs pus mo'i phyi zur du bzung*/ de'i kha la hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od zer dang bcas pa me lha'i ljags rtser raṃ bsams pas sngags oṃ āḥhūm̐ sngon du 'gro bas/ me lha'i snying po'i mthar oṃ ag+na ya che ge mā ra ya phaṭ btags pas spyi bskos lan bdun/ de nas yaṃ shing*/ oṃ badz+rā ya/ mar nag liṅga/ me lha'i sngags/ liṅga re sngags re bstun pas phul/ lhag ma thams cad sngags de kho nas so// lugs 'di la dūrba ku sha 'bul ba mi byed/ de nas me lha thab nas byon te kha khyer gyi shar lhor bzhugs su gsol/ thab nas me mgal gcig phyung ste der bzhag me dbus su lha bskyed spyan drangs/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na ye shes pa dar lam byas te/ de nas tshom bur spyan drangs thab khung du bzhugs gsol rgyas btab kyi bar byas/ dam bsgrag las bya bar zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ drag po'i mchod pa sman rag gtor ma phul/ bstod pa'i bar byas nas/ gser skyems nas bsgral ba'i bar byas/ de nas dgang blugs kyis spyi bskos lan bdun phul/ de nas yaṃ shing mar khu/ lid+ga sogs thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ la rtsa sngags btags pas phul/ gzhung bzhin nam dmigs bya bsgral ba'i phyir du 'dod gsol byas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// sogs kyi bzod par gsol/

ye shes pa gshegs pa'am/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na sngar bzhin mthar spyan drangs de la bstim/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ de nas me lha me dbus su spyan drangs pa la chu gsum nyer mchod/ bstod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// de nas de'i sman rag gtor ma oṃ a kā ros phul/ 'dod pa gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon cing*// bdag la dngos grub kun 'grub mdzod// oṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha zhes gshegs/ thal ba cha gsum du btang ste gcig dgra phyogs su rlung la phyar/ gcig mnan/ gcig phyin chad kyi dgos par bzhag go /zhes pad+ma dkar po bla ma dang lha las gnang ba thob pa des dkar rgyud chos sdings su sbyar ba'o/// /mad+galaṃ/// /
